answer: Each agent identity is admitted by an SGX/TPM trusted-execution enclave producing a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a hardware key and the ocean state tree. The tide hash anchor and oasis consensus contract reject reused measurements and stale proofs. Forging identities requires compromising distinct attested hardware or repeatedly recomputing enclave proofs; registration bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, and failed attestations irreversibly slash collateral.
